title: The inverse open projection respects the counit
statement: Let J:C→D be left adjoint to Q:D→C [lem-weil-pbc-adjunction-of-natural-bijection], between symmetric monoidal categories [def-sfb-monoidal-category], and let Q be symmetric strong monoidal [def-sfb-strong-monoidal-functor]. For H,M in D suppose the unit-defined right-coefficient projection k(QM,H):J(QM⊗QH)→J(QM)⊗H is invertible. Then β(H,JQM);k(QM,H)⁻¹;J(β(QM,QH));J(μ(H,M));ε(H⊗M)=H⊗ε(M).

source.place: last paragraph: projection formula on chosen compactifications and the ordered affine-line tower; categorical calculations making coefficient normalization explicit

proof.text:
the unit-defined right-coefficient projection satisfies the counit equation
by transposition and the right triangle identity. Braidedness moves the swap through
the tensorator, and counit naturality moves the resulting mapped swap past the
counit. The inverse projection cancels and symmetry naturality gives the claimed
left-coefficient equation.

theorem openCounit_tensorAction
    {C D : Type*} [Category* C] [Category* D]
    [MonoidalCategory C] [SymmetricCategory C]
    [MonoidalCategory D] [SymmetricCategory D]
    {J : C ⥤ D} {Q : D ⥤ C} (adj : J ⊣ Q) [Q.Braided]
    (H M : D)
    [IsIso (((adj.projectionMap Q (curriedTensor C) (curriedTensor D)
      (Functor.LaxMonoidal.μNatTrans Q)).app (Q.obj M)).app H)] :
    (β_ H (J.obj (Q.obj M))).hom ≫
      inv (((adj.projectionMap Q (curriedTensor C) (curriedTensor D)
        (Functor.LaxMonoidal.μNatTrans Q)).app (Q.obj M)).app H) ≫
      J.map (β_ (Q.obj M) (Q.obj H)).hom ≫
      J.map (Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ Q H M) ≫ adj.counit.app (H ⊗ M) =
        H ◁ adj.counit.app M
